items.title: Cohomology on the big etale site computes cohomology on the small one, with the six comparison identities
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects six identifications between cohomology computed on the big etale site over S and on the small etale sites of S and T (statement lines 21274-21291). The proof (proof lines 21293-21305) uses K-injective representatives and the injectivity comparison for the abelian cases, with the identity i_f^{-1}pi_S^{-1} = f_small^{-1}, and the general cocontinuous comparison together with the factorisation of Lf_small^* for the module cases. H2: two short reductions covering six statements, written out.
